help.title: PDFTools Help
help.description: A free PDF viewer and editor that works offline. Your documents never leave this device.

start.title: Opening files
start.body: Press {{open}}, drop PDF files on the window, or open a recent file from File → Recent. Each file opens in its own tab. Password-protected files ask for their password.

view.title: Viewing
view.body: Zoom with {{zoomIn}} and {{zoomOut}} or {{mod}}+mouse wheel; {{fitPage}} fits the page and {{fitWidth}} the width. Hold Space or press H to pan. The View tab has page layouts and rotation. {{fullScreen}} or the full-screen button at the top right shows the whole app full screen; Esc leaves.

find.title: Finding text
find.body: {{find}} opens Quick Find; press Enter to search and {{findNext}} for the next hit. {{advancedSearch}} opens Advanced Search, which also looks in comments, bookmarks and other open documents.

panes.title: Side panes
panes.body: The rail on the left opens Thumbnails, Bookmarks, Attachments, Layers, Signatures and Search. Esc returns to the rail.

review.title: Reviewing comments
review.body: The Comment tab has the markup, note, text and drawing tools; single letters such as N (note) or B (rectangle) turn them on while the document has focus. Select a comment with Home → Select Comments or from the Comments pane; then edit it in the Properties pane, reply or set its status in the Comments pane, and remove it with Comment → Delete or the {{delete}} key ({{undo}} brings it back). In the Comments pane, Options sorts, groups and filters the cards and Find (Enter) looks through their text and replies; a card's Reply opens a reply box (Enter posts, Esc cancels), F2 edits its text, and a right click gives the same menu as on the page. {{save}} keeps your comments in the file. On a file that forbids changes, comments are read-only.

transfer.title: Comment transfer
transfer.body: Comment → Import brings comments from another PDF or a PDFTools JSON export into the open file; Export writes them as CSV, Excel or JSON, and Export CRS builds a comment resolution sheet. Copy, Cut and Paste move the selected comments within a document and between open documents: {{copy}}, {{cut}} and {{paste}}, or right-click a comment ({{menu}} from the keyboard). {{paste}} puts them on the page you last clicked, at the same place; Paste from the right-click menu puts them where you clicked. Paste to Original Pages puts them on the pages they came from.

measure.title: Measuring
measure.body: Measure → Distance, Perimeter and Area draw measurements on the page. Set the drawing's scale first: Calibrate by clicking two points of a known length, or Set Scale to type a ratio; Scale Viewport gives part of a page its own scale. Snapping to endpoints, midpoints, intersections and nearby lines is on the Measure tab, and Units sets the units and precision.

tables.title: Extracting tables
tables.body: Convert → Express Extract (Beta) saves the tables PDFTools finds on the chosen pages as an Excel workbook or CSV files. Review & Extract shows the detected grids on the page so you can add, move or delete dividers, mark header rows and merged cells, and save the grid as a template for similar pages. Scanned pages have no text to extract.

redact.title: Redacting
redact.body: Protect → Mark for Redaction marks the selected text and Mark Area for Redaction marks a rectangle; Pending Redactions lists the marks. Apply Redactions writes a new, fully rewritten file with the marked text, images and drawings removed and the document's hidden data cleared, and checks it before saving. The original file is not changed.

forms.title: Forms
forms.body: Click a form field or press Tab to move through the fields. {{save}} saves the values. Home → Reset Form restores the defaults.

save.title: Saving
save.body: {{save}} adds your changes to the end of the file as an incremental update, so earlier signed revisions are kept as they were; the Signatures pane shows whether each one is still intact. Save As writes a copy; Save Optimized rewrites the file compactly. Unsaved work is kept on this device in case the browser closes.

print.title: Printing
print.body: {{print}} opens the print dialog: choose pages, size, markups and quality. Large drawings print sharpest through the browser's PDF viewer. File → Export Print-Ready PDF saves a copy with markups and form values burned in.

protect.title: Protected and signed files
protect.body: Protect → Security Info shows what a file allows; PDFTools honours those restrictions. Password Security saves a copy with an open password, a permissions password or both (AES-256); Remove Security saves a copy without them. Both need the owner password of an already protected file. Sign Document places a signature or initials you draw, type or upload as a picture (a standard comment, or page content if you flatten it); it is not a certificate-based digital signature. Saved signatures stay on this device. Signatures are checked on this device; the Signatures pane shows whether each signed part is unchanged.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: PDFTools makes no network requests with your documents; on its own it only loads its program files and checks for updates from its website. Error reports are sent only when you choose to, and you see every word of them first. The OpenEngTools and GitHub buttons open those websites in a new tab and send nothing by themselves.

signed.body: The signatures stay valid for the version that was signed. After the next save they are shown as "changed after signing".

error.syntax: Use page numbers and ranges, e.g. 1-3, 8.
error.outOfRange: Some pages are not in this document.
error.noSelection: Select pages in the Thumbnails pane first.
error.all: A document needs at least one page: not every page can be deleted.
error.page: Enter a page number from 1 to {{max}}.

delete.title: Delete Pages
delete.description: The pages are removed from this document. Undo brings them back; nothing is written to the file until you save.

insert.title: Insert Blank Page
insert.description: Adds empty pages to this document.

move.title: Move Pages
move.description: Moves the pages to another place in this document, in their current order.

file.restricted: This file's security settings don't allow its pages to be copied. Open it with the owner password.
file.unreadable: This file could not be opened as a PDF.
file.forms: Form fields on these pages will not be fillable.

insertFile.title: Insert from File
insertFile.description: Inserts pages of another PDF into this document.

extract.title: Extract Pages
extract.description: Copies the pages, with your unsaved changes, into a new document in its own tab. It is not saved until you save it.
extract.alsoDelete: Also delete them from this document
extract.restricted: Pages can leave this encrypted document only when it is open with the owner password.

merge.title: Merge Files
merge.description: Combines PDF files into a new document in its own tab, with one bookmark per file. The files themselves are not changed.

express.title: Express Extract (Beta)
express.description: Finds the tables on the pages and saves them as a spreadsheet. Done on this device; nothing is sent anywhere.
express.pages_one: Page {{list}} (select pages in the Thumbnails pane to search others).
express.xlsx: Excel workbook (.xlsx), one sheet per table
express.folderNote: The CSV files go into the folder you choose.
express.zipNote: The CSV files are saved as one ZIP file.
express.beta: Beta: check the result. Tables with unusual layouts may need Review & Extract.
express.none: No tables found on these pages.
express.ocr_one: Page {{list}} has no text layer: tables on scanned pages need OCR, which is planned.
express.ocr_other: Pages {{list}} have no text layer: tables on scanned pages need OCR, which is planned.
express.failed: The tables could not be extracted. Nothing was saved.

review.title: Review & Extract (Beta)
review.beta: Beta: check each table's dividers before exporting. Nothing here changes the PDF.
review.drawHelp: Drag on the page to draw a table, or move the outline at the page's centre with the arrow keys (Shift+arrows resize, Enter adds it, Esc cancels).
review.nothingToUndo: Nothing to undo in Review & Extract
review.nothingToRedo: Nothing to redo in Review & Extract
review.empty: No tables yet. Find tables on a page or draw one.
review.dividerHelp: Drag a divider, or focus it: arrow keys move it (Shift: 10 points), Delete removes it, Insert adds one next to it, Esc returns here. Double-click in the table adds a column divider (Shift: a row divider).
review.keyRectHelp: Arrow keys move it, Shift+arrow keys resize it, Enter adds the table, Esc cancels.
review.previewHelp: Select cells with the arrow keys (Shift extends). M merges the selected cells, U splits a merged cell, H makes the rows up to the selection header rows; Shift+F10 opens the menu.
review.none_one: No new tables found on this page.
review.none_other: No new tables found on these pages.
review.drawn: Table added. Add dividers to split it into columns and rows.
review.failed: The tables could not be read. Nothing was saved.

templates.title: Table Templates (Beta)
templates.description: Grids you saved from Review & Extract, applied to pages of the same size and rotation. Kept on this device only.
templates.empty: No templates yet. In Review & Extract, select a table and choose Save as Template.
templates.name: Name
templates.skipped_one: Page {{list}} was skipped: its size or rotation differs from the template's page.
templates.skipped_other: Pages {{list}} were skipped: their size or rotation differs from the template's page.
templates.noneFit: None of these pages has the template's page size and rotation.
templates.failed: The tables could not be extracted. Nothing was saved.

redact.keyRectHelp: Arrow keys move it (Ctrl: 1 point), Shift+arrow keys resize it, Enter marks the area, Esc ends.

panel.title: Pending Redactions
panel.empty: No marks yet. Use Mark for Redaction on selected text or Mark Area for Redaction.
panel.applyLater: Marks are saved with the document (Ctrl+S) and can be applied later. Applying them creates a new, redacted copy; this document stays as it is.

apply.title: Apply Redactions
apply.description: Removes the marked content for good, in a new file. Done on this device; nothing is sent anywhere.
apply.summary_one: {{marks}} mark on {{pages}} page will be applied.
apply.summary_other: {{marks}} marks on {{pages}} pages will be applied.
apply.newFile: A new file is created ({{name}}). The open document and the original file stay as they are.
apply.removesLabel: The new file will not contain:

removes.content: text, images and drawing inside the marked areas (replaced by black boxes)
removes.annotations: comments, links and form fields over the marked areas, and bookmarks pointing into them
removes.metadata: document properties and XMP metadata, page thumbnails
removes.hidden: tagging (structure tree), JavaScript, attached files and private application data

apply.signed_one: This document has {{n}} digital signature. It will not be valid in the redacted file.
apply.signed_other: This document has {{n}} digital signatures. They will not be valid in the redacted file.
apply.checksPassed: Checked: no text, image, drawing or comment is left inside any marked area, and no redacted word can be found in the file.
apply.annotationsRemoved_one: {{n}} comment, link or field over a marked area was removed.
apply.annotationsRemoved_other: {{n}} comments, links or fields over marked areas were removed.
apply.simplified: Some drawing details around marked areas were simplified (clipping, blending or layer membership of cut lines).
apply.failedVerify: Redaction could not be verified, so nothing was saved. Content may remain at:
apply.noMarks: There are no marks to apply.
apply.failed: The redaction could not be completed. Nothing was saved.

check.string: a redacted word found elsewhere in the file
check.structure: hidden document data or more than one revision

ocr.title: Recognize Text (OCR)
ocr.description: Scanned pages get an invisible text layer, so their text can be searched, selected and copied. Recognition runs on this device; nothing is sent anywhere.
ocr.skipNote: Pages that already have text are skipped unless the option below is on.
ocr.restricted: This document's security settings don't allow changes.
ocr.nothing: No text was found on the selected pages; {{skipped}} already had text.
ocr.failed: The text could not be recognized. The document is as it was before.

error.syntax: Use page numbers and ranges, e.g. 1-3, 8.
error.outOfRange: Some pages are not in this document.
error.noSelection: Select pages in the Thumbnails pane first.
error.noDocument: The document is no longer open.

languages.downloadNote: Languages other than English are downloaded when first used ({{size}}) and then kept for offline use.

ocr.reRecognize: Also recognize pages that already have text (a text layer this app added before is replaced; other text stays)

topBar.fullScreenUnavailable: This browser doesn't allow full screen here

sign.title: Sign Document
sign.description: Place a signature or initials on {{name}}: choose Place, then click on the page (Enter puts it in the middle of the page, Esc cancels).
sign.visualOnly: This is a visual signature, not a certificate-based digital signature: it shows your signature on the page but does not prove who signed or that the file is unchanged.

draw.hint: Draw with a mouse, pen or finger. From the keyboard, use Type or Image.

upload.unsupported: This file is not a PNG or JPG image PDFTools can read.
upload.empty: Nothing is left to place: the image is blank (or all white).

options.save: Save on this device for next time
